text:
deploy-bot: starting rollout for release v2.7.4 to prod in 10m. feature flag `model-routing-v2` will be toggled: 0% -> 10% -> 50% cohorts. timelock window 22:00-23:00 UTC (no manual flips after start). docs: https://redwood.dev/rel/2.7.4-notes :rocket:

olivia: copying notes here — small change: fallback to v2.6 path for legacy clients, we pin group `cohort-legacy` to v2.6 for the rollout.

sam: ramp schedule?

maya: plan: +10% at t=0, +40% at t=30m if steady. if p95 latency up >200ms or 5xx rate >0.8% we pause and hold for investigation. manual rollback == pin cohorts back to v2.6.

luis: add backpressure trigger: if queue depth on learn-router > 500 for 2 consecutive 1m windows -> auto-drain new cohorts and revert routing to 100% v2.6.

olivia: agreed. Also set canary flag `model-routing-v2-canary` for internal traffic only until +10%.

oncall-bot: reminder: oncall maya is primary for next 2h, luis is backup. paging policy unchanged.

anya: quick question — what's the exact rollback command?

sam: use:
```
deploy flag set model-routing-v2 --cohort stable --percent 0
deploy pin cohort-legacy --version v2.6
```
then run `infra rollback routing` if we see cascading failures.

maya: add to checklist: update release note w/ rollback steps and escalation path, tag slack #incidents if we hit the thresholds. I'll post a short summary when we hit 10%.

luis: also instrument a short-lived metric `rr_policy_mismatch` to catch incorrect pins during shift. set alert at >=5/min.

oncall-bot: deploy started by olivia at 1995001244.

deploy-bot: toggled `model-routing-v2` to 10% cohorts=stable at 1995001245. streaming logs: `router:route_v2 -> 10%`, `errors:0.02%`, `p95: 78ms`.

olivia: monitoring dashboards up. baseline p95=70ms, errors=0.01%.

maya: holding 30m watch window. if metrics stable, proceed to 50% at 1995001525 (t+30m).

sam: note for release notes: mention `timelock` prevents manual flips between 22:00-23:00 UTC — ops only for emergency.

luis: if we need an emergency rollback before timelock end, we follow emergency unblock flow: ops-command -> exec `deploy emergency-unlock --token $SE_TOKEN` then run rollback. keep audit.

olivia: thanks team. I'll post post-rollout summary and attach traffic traces.

maya: tagging: @oncall-bot pls escalate to infra if auto-drain triggers.

deploy-bot: next scheduled step in 30m unless a hold is requested.
